# discord_bans (Data Source)

Lists the users banned from a server in ascending order of user ID. Requires the Ban Members or View Audit Log permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_bans" "recent" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  limit     = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of bans to return. Defaults to all of them, fetched in pages of 1000.

### Read-Only

- `bans` (Attributes List) The bans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bans))

<a id="nestedatt--bans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bans`

Read-Only:

- `reason` (String) Reason for the ban.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the banned user.
- `username` (String) Username of the banned user.
